hints.org_admin: Manages members, API keys, devices, alert rules and the audit log of the organization.
hints.fleet_manager: Manages the fleet: vessels, telemetry, CII and SEEMP, alert rules and zones.
hints.authority: Supervision across organizations: alerts, safety and surveillance of every fleet.
hints.viewer: Read-only access to the organization's vessels, maps and alerts.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Tenants of the platform: shipping companies, authorities, research institutes and the platform operator.
organizations.noMatchesHint: Try another name or kind, or clear the filters.
organizations.emptyHint: Create the first organization: a shipping company, an authority or a research institute.

form.description: The kind decides which roles its members can hold: the authority role exists in authority organizations only.
form.name: Name
form.slugHint: Short identifier in URLs: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
form.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens (at most 63 characters)
form.platformKind: The platform organization always keeps the kind Platform.

kindHints.shipping_company: Operates vessels: fleet, telemetry, CII and SEEMP of its own ships.
kindHints.authority: Port, coast guard or ministry: may grant the authority role to supervise every fleet.
kindHints.research: University or institute with read access for studies.

users.emptyHint: Users appear here once they are invited to an organization.
users.confirmDisableText: The user is signed out on every device and can no longer sign in until the account is enabled again.
users.confirmEnableText: The user can sign in again with their current password.

toasts.failed: The account status could not be changed

members.authorityOrg: Authority organization: the authority role is available.
members.nonAuthorityOrg: The authority role is available in authority organizations only.
members.noOrgHint: Choose an organization to see and manage its members.
members.emptyHint: Invite the first member by e-mail; they join when they accept the link.

invitations.emptyHint: Invitations you send appear here until they are accepted or withdrawn.

invite.name: Name
invite.authorityHint: The authority role is available in authority organizations only.
invite.consent: Nobody is added without consent: the membership starts when the invitee accepts the e-mailed link and chooses a password.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Keys for telemetry devices, AIS feeds and partner integrations. The secret is shown only once, when the key is created.
apiKeys.emptyHint: Create a key for a telemetry device or an integration, then store its secret in that system.

scopes.telemetry_ingest: Send fuel readings of the organization's vessels (HTTP telemetry devices).
scopes.ais_read: Read AIS positions and vessel data through the API.
scopes.ais_ingest: Push AIS messages into the shared feed of every tenant (platform administrators only).

guide.title: Scopes
guide.description: Grant each key only the scopes its system needs.
guide.header: Systems send the key in the X-API-Key header. A key works until it is revoked or reaches its expiry date; rotation issues a new secret while the old one keeps working for the grace period. Revoke a key as soon as a device or partner no longer needs it.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revokeConfirm.description: Requests with this key are refused at once, and devices linked to it stop sending data. This cannot be undone.

form.title: New API key
form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the key

secret.title: Copy the key now
secret.onceText: Only a hash of the key is stored. If it is lost, revoke it and create a new one.
secret.stored: I have stored the key in a safe place

toasts.revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked
toasts.rotateFailed: The key could not be rotated

rotate.title: Rotate key {{name}}
rotate.description: A new secret is created for the same key (same id and prefix) and shown once. Devices still using the old secret keep working during the grace period.
rotate.grace: Grace period of the old secret
rotate.graceHint: After the grace period only the new secret is accepted.

referenceData.title: Reference Data
referenceData.description: Vessel types, fuels, engines, first fuel formulas, ports and the ship registry used by the emission and CII computations.

hints.vessel-types: IMO ship types with the CII reference line (a, c) and the rating boundaries d1–d4.
hints.fuels: Fuels with their CO₂ conversion factor Cf, carbon content and density.
hints.engines: Main and auxiliary engines with power, speed and specific fuel oil consumption (SFOC).
hints.formulas: Vessel-specific fuel-flow regressions of speed, checked against the safe formula grammar.
hints.ports: Ports of call with location and arrival radius.
hints.registry: Particulars of ships outside the fleet (registry search by name, IMO or MMSI).

reference.emptyHint: Platform administrators add reference data here; the seeds provide the IMO defaults.

form.code: Lowercase letters and digits, separated by single underscores (e.g. bulk_carrier)

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Rows still used by a vessel cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone.

toasts.saveFailed: The entry could not be saved
toasts.deleteFailed: The entry could not be deleted

vesselTypes.formHint: Parameters of the CII reference line and rating (MEPC.353(78), MEPC.354(78)).
vesselTypes.capacityFixedHint: Capacity used instead of the vessel's own (empty = the vessel's DWT or GT).
vesselTypes.ddOrder: The boundaries must increase: d1 < d2 < d3 < d4

fuels.formHint: CO₂ per tonne of fuel and the density used for volume readings (MEPC.364(79)).
fuels.cf: Conversion factor Cf (t CO₂ / t fuel)

engines.formHint: Engine data of the Holtrop fuel path (MCR × SFOC × time).

formulas.formHint: Fuel flow of the main and auxiliary engines as a function of speedKnot (L/min).
formulas.grammar: Numbers, speedKnot, + − * / ^ ( ), and exp, log, ln, sqrt, pow, abs, min, max (optionally with Math.). At most 500 characters.

ports.formHint: Location (WGS 84) and the radius within which a vessel counts as arrived.

registry.searchPlaceholder: Name, IMO or MMSI (at least 2 characters)…
registry.promptHint: Type at least two characters of a name, an IMO number or an MMSI.

formula.previewCaption: Fuel flow computed by the formula at several speeds

problems.tooManyTokens: The formula has more than {{max}} tokens (character {{position}})
problems.tooDeep: Nested too deeply around character {{position}} (at most {{max}} levels)
problems.unknownIdentifier: Unknown name “{{token}}” at character {{position}}: use speedKnot or exp, log, ln, sqrt, pow, abs, min, max
problems.numberOutOfRange: Number “{{token}}” is out of range at character {{position}}

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Telemetry devices that report fuel readings: MQTT gateways on board and HTTP flow meters with their own API key.
devices.noMatchesHint: Try another name, vessel or status, or clear the filters.
devices.emptyHint: Register the flow meter or MQTT gateway of a vessel to start receiving fuel readings.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.description: The device can no longer send readings. Readings it already sent are kept.

form.description: A device reports the fuel readings of one vessel of the organization.
form.moveHint: Moving the device to another vessel applies to new readings only.
form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Enter a name for the device

kindHints.mqtt: Publishes readings to its own MQTT topic; no API key needed.
kindHints.http: Posts readings to the REST API with its own API key (scope telemetry:ingest).

form.apiKeyRequired: HTTP devices need an API key with the scope telemetry:ingest
form.apiKeyHint: Only active keys with the scope telemetry:ingest that no other device uses.

connection.title: Connection guide
connection.description: How {{name}} sends the fuel readings of {{vessel}}.

mqtt.broker: Connect to the platform MQTT broker below as the device's broker user; the platform operator provisions its password.
mqtt.topic: Publish to the device's own topic below with QoS 1.
mqtt.payload: Send one reading as JSON, or an array of up to 1000 readings; the vessel is the device's.

http.key: Use the API key linked to the device (shown once when it was created).
http.request: POST the readings as JSON to the telemetry API, at most 1000 per request.
http.vessel: The MMSI must be the device's vessel; other vessels are refused.

rules.units: Fuel in tonnes: fuelMeTon (main engines) and fuelAeTon (auxiliary engines), never negative.
rules.time: time is the end of the measured period in UTC (ISO 8601); periodStart is optional.
rules.unique: One reading per vessel and instant: exact repeats are ignored, different values at the same time are refused.
rules.active: Only active devices may send; deactivate a device instead of deleting it to pause it.

toasts.saveFailed: The device could not be saved
toasts.deleteFailed: The device could not be deleted

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.description: Who did what, when and from where, across every service. Records are kept for two years.
auditLog.noMatchesHint: Widen the time range or clear a filter.
auditLog.empty: No audit records in the last 30 days
auditLog.emptyHint: Sign-ins and changes to members, keys, vessels and rules appear here as they happen.

detail.title: Audit record
detail.noMeta: This record carries no further details.
